title: Direct measurement of PFAS levels in surface water using an engineered biosensor
content:
RSC Sustain., 2024, 2,3967-3972
DOI: 10.1039/D4SU00349G, Paper

We use a protein-based biosensor to detect perfluorooctanoic acid (PFOA) in surface water samples, with comparable results to LC-MS/MS.
